description:
Located in the heart of Dublin’s IFSC, Mayor Square offers well-equipped student accommodation with excellent transport links and easy access to universities, shops, and amenities. The residence provides a comfortable and secure living environment with modern facilities designed for both study and social life.

A range of Deluxe en-suite rooms are available from €301 per week. These are single-occupancy bedrooms with private en-suite bathrooms, ranging from 12m² to 14m². Each room is fully furnished with a single bed (1,900mm x 1,200mm), wardrobe, shelving, smart storage, blinds, study desk with light, adjustable chair, and personal radiator. Apartments are shared with 6–8 other residents and include a fully equipped kitchen and living space.

Contract options for 2026/27 include a full academic year (August 2026 to June 2027, 44 weeks) and a full year (August 2026 to August 2027, 51 weeks).

Please note: Twin en-suite rooms are currently fully booked and a waiting list is in operation.

Prices quoted exclude a fixed weekly service charge of €35, which covers heating, hot water, WiFi, and waste disposal.

Residents benefit from high-speed internet, fully fitted kitchens with appliances and cookware, parcel and delivery services at reception, on-site laundry facilities, maintenance support, secure keyless entry with 24/7 CCTV, and bike storage.

Mayor Square is ideally located within walking distance of the National College of Ireland (1 minute), Tesco Express (3 minutes), and Trinity College Dublin (approximately 20 minutes). The property is also well connected by the LUAS Red Line and multiple bus routes, providing easy access across Dublin city.

Please note there is no summer availability at this residence. Room availability is limited and may fluctuate.

To enquire or secure a room, please get in touch with StudentHouse.
